title: 采样与对比
subtitle: 在书籍的几段摘录上并排运行多个 LLM 配置——无需完整翻译。
drop_file_support: 支持 PDF、TXT、EPUB、SRT、DOCX 和文本文件
remove_file: 移除此书并选择另一本
update_samples_title: 应用 N 和最大字符数：重新对文档采样，尽可能保留已有的翻译。
no_results_yet: 请在上方选择文档以查看采样区块。
no_samples_left: 所有样本已删除。使用「添加样本」可再抽取一个。
cell_pending: 点击此处，用该 LLM 翻译此摘录。
warning_small_document: 文档只有 {{total}} 个区块；已采样 {{count}} 个内部区块（请求 {{requested}}）。
warning_lang_autodetected: 已自动检测源语言为 {{lang}}（置信度 {{confidence}}%）。
error_no_file: 请先选择一个书籍文件。
error_no_samples: 没有可翻译的样本 — 至少添加一个。
error_llm_missing_model: The selected pipeline model is empty — pick a model before running.
no_more_indices: 此文档已没有可用的位置。
section_document_hint: Upload a book and inspect a few representative chunks before running.
section_model_hint: Every variant uses the same model so the difference comes from the pipeline, not the provider.
section_variants_hint: Choose one glossary, one profile, and an optional transformation. The app generates the useful variants automatically.
variant_base_desc: Direct translation with the chosen model, without glossary or profile.
variant_glossary_desc: Same translation with approved terms injected from the selected glossary.
variant_profile_desc: Same translation using the profile's editorial policy and internal glossary.
variant_profile_glossary_desc: Combines the editorial profile with the selected external glossary.
variant_transform_desc: Translates first, then applies the transformation to the result.
integrated_hint: Joins the selected fragments in order so each pipeline reads as one continuous sample.
integrated_pending: Pending: this fragment does not have final output yet.
error_no_variants: No pipeline variants are available. Choose a model and at least one variant.
